novelty_findings.finding: Existing scale-area generators and error diagnosis do not explicitly require comparing both side pairs from two independent plans.
novelty_findings.mandatory_counterexample: 4x3m vs 6x2m have same area but not the same rectangle; rotations must be accepted.

novelty_findings.finding: Existing semicircle perimeter includes its diameter, while rectangle+semicircle tasks ask for area not combined exterior perimeter.
novelty_findings.mandatory_counterexample: Summing two complete perimeters double-counts the joined diameter.

novelty_findings.finding: Existing relative-error comparisons identify precision, not admissibility against a fixed external tolerance.
novelty_findings.mandatory_counterexample: The more precise measurement can still exceed tolerance, and exact equality must pass.

limitations: Full set of 128 descriptive records checked, NOT full implementation audits for all 128 types.
Screening flags do not prove independent pedagogical families.
No family/new generator or levels approved; N3 remains hypothetical.
Absence of a feature in a short description does not prove it is absent in full implementation.
